repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate computes an absolute difference (lines 4-7) before checking the condition, whereas the IR requires a signed difference ($t2 - $t1) to be checked directly. Evidence F2 shows the JoI emitted an action when the IR did not, implying the JoI condition evaluated true while the IR's signed condition was false (e.g., a temperature drop). The candidate's logic inverts negative drops into positive values, triggering the action incorrectly.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the absolute-value logic (lines 4-7) and the intermediate `diff` variable. The script now directly computes and checks the signed difference ($t2 - $t1) as specified in the IR, ensuring the action only fires when the temperature rises by at least 3 units.
